evals.prompt: Add a project skill that reviews our database queries before we merge.
evals.expected_output: Checks for an existing skill, proposes a unique name and a trigger description, creates SKILL.md and evals, and registers it.
assertions: Checks docs/EXTENSIONS.md and existing skills for duplicates
Uses a unique lowercase hyphenated name
Description says what it does and when to use it
Creates evals/evals.json with 4 to 6 evals including a non-trigger case
Keeps the SKILL.md body under 120 lines

evals.prompt: Add a hook that blocks editing anything in the migrations folder.
evals.expected_output: Creates a script that exits 2 with a clear message, registers it in settings, and adds a block and an allow test.
assertions: Exit code 2 blocks and the message says what to do instead
Includes at least one blocking and one allowing test
Registers the hook in .claude/settings.json and EXTENSIONS.md

evals.prompt: Add a subagent that plans the backend migration for us.
evals.expected_output: Creates a read-only agent with a trigger description, small tool set, a model, and no nested agents.
assertions: Description says when to hand work to it
Instructions include current state and target
